Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpretation of explicit temporal data (Chronological Error). In Step 4, the Planner incorrectly stated that "Xenoa release: August 22, 2017" in the "Updated Understanding" section. This contradicts the data gathered in Step 1, where the WebSurfer explicitly found the release date to be "August 22, 2007" (confirmed by both Wikipedia and IMDb snippets in Step 1). This error in data transcription led the Planner to incorrectly conclude that Divorce Invitation (2012) was released earlier than Xenoa (2017), whereas the correct comparison (2007 vs 2012) shows Xenoa was released earlier.
